name: The Landlord
dream: Build a house, become a landlord
story: Ten years of cement bags and ajo contributions. 89% of his money came from his own work — the only fully solo dream in the set, and the one that finished closest to its target (92.6%).
caveat: His climb looks slow next to the others — that is the point. Discipline reads as a gentle slope, not a spike.
